facts.en: Completed a communications diploma at Fictional Clover College in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构三叶草学院完成传播文凭课程。

facts.en: Workshop support assistant at Fictional Mosaic Lessons from 2022-03 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-03 至 2026-08 在虚构马赛克课程机构任工作坊支持助理。

facts.en: Prepared workshop materials and sent attendance reminders using approved text.
facts.zh: 准备工作坊材料并使用获批文字发送出席提醒。

facts.en: Answered schedule questions and referred technical teaching questions to instructors.
facts.zh: 回答排期问题并将技术教学问题转交讲师。

facts.en: Supported a 2025-06 workshop attended by 40 people.
facts.zh: 支持一场于 2025-06 举办、40 人出席的工作坊。

facts.en: Only 5 of the 40 attendees returned a voluntary feedback form; those 5 respondents had an average score of 4.8 out of 5.
facts.zh: 40 名出席者仅有 5 名自愿交回反馈表；这 5 人平均评分为 4.8 分，满分 5 分。

facts.en: The score describes those 5 respondents only and is not an overall customer rating or evidence of representativeness.
facts.zh: 该分数仅描述这 5 名答卷者，不是整体客户评分，也不证明代表性。

facts.en: Personally entered the responses; an instructor reviewed the summary and owned the teaching content.
facts.zh: 个人录入答复；讲师审核摘要并负责教学内容。

facts.en: Separated response counts from attendance counts in reports.
facts.zh: 在报表中区分答卷数量与出席数量。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet averages, response logs and presentation templates.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格平均值、答复日志及演示模板。

facts.en: Co-designed a materials checklist with an instructor in 2025-09.
facts.zh: 2025-09 与讲师共同设计材料核对表。

facts.en: For 6 sessions during 2025-10, 5 material packs were ready by the agreed deadline; no prior comparable measure was available.
facts.zh: 2025-10 的 6 场活动中，5 份材料包在约定期限前就绪；无此前可比指标。

facts.en: Drafted an automated feedback reminder in 2026-02; it was not sent or deployed.
facts.zh: 2026-02 起草自动反馈提醒；未发送或部署。

facts.en: A 2021 class presentation used fictional survey data; it was not customer research employment.
facts.zh: 2021 年课堂演示使用虚构调查数据；并非客户研究工作。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Garden Table from 2023-05 to 2023-08 alongside employment.
facts.zh: 2023-05 至 2023-08 工作同期在虚构花园桌做志愿者。

facts.en: Arranged seed-exchange table labels, unrelated to the workshop feedback sample.
facts.zh: 安排种子交换桌标签，与工作坊反馈样本无关。

facts.en: Enjoys photographing handmade miniature rooms.
facts.zh: 爱好拍摄手工微型房间。

facts.en: Maintained a dated issue list and followed up with the relevant instructor.
facts.zh: 维护带日期的问题清单并向相关讲师跟进。

facts.en: A draft CV calls 4.8 out of 5 the overall customer rating; the response log does not support that description.
facts.zh: 简历草稿将满分 5 分中的 4.8 分称为整体客户评分；答复日志不支持该描述。

facts.en: No statistical sampling design or independent instructional authority is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录统计抽样设计或独立教学权限。
